title: GetClass - ActorBase
content:
Member of: ActorBase Script

Obtains this actor's Class.

Syntax:
Class Function GetClass() native

Parameters:
None.

Return Value:
The Class the actor is.

Examples:
; Get the class that the player is
ActorBase PlayerBase = Game.GetPlayer().GetBaseObject() as ActorBase
Class PlayerClass = PlayerBase.GetClass()
